name: dftracer_diagnose
description: Diagnosis stage of the dftracer pipeline: score dfanalyzer checkpoints with DFDiagnoser into a ranked high/critical bottleneck list (diagnose, session_diagnose_bottlenecks -> diagnosis.json) and map symptoms to causes; dftracer_diagnose_check validates the diagnosis. Load after analysis, before optimizing, or on 'traces_split not found', 'dfanalyzer ran but produced no _flat_view_*.parquet', 'DFDiagnoser did not run successfully', 'No module named dfdiagnoser', or a diagnosis whose numbers disagree with event_count.

history.why: converted from dftracer-agents dfdiagnoser_service (diagnose, session_diagnose_bottlenecks), the dftracer-diagnoser skill (rules, pitfalls, lessons, permissions) and agent
